The main takeaway from our work is that
ezrin expression in preoperative biopsied samples of rectal cancer patients is associated with disease outcome, whereas the expression in radiated operative samples is not.
ezrin expression in preoperative biopsy samples may be a valuable predictive marker for disease-free and disease-specific survival in rectal cancer.
